Katie, saw Uncountable landed the DuPont collaboration and a Showa Denko partnership while hosting your Unify Summit.

Logos like that usually mean more enterprise R&D accounts in play than the team can cover before the pipeline cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Uncountable off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Katie, quick follow-up for Uncountable.

Marquee logos usually pull the number up faster than the headcount you can add to chase the next wave of enterprise accounts. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Uncountable needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Katie, last bit of proof for Uncountable.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Uncountable's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise R&D software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
